title: Bún bò — 15s vertical hook / Bún bò — hook dọc 15 giây

world.product: One bowl of bún bò Huế: round white ceramic bowl with a plain rim, clear red-orange broth, round rice noodles, two slices of shank, one slice of pork knuckle, spring onion and raw onion on top
world.person: One fictional adult vendor, hands and forearms only, no face in frame
world.location: A small pavement shop: stainless counter, one steel stock pot camera-left, stacked bowls camera-right, morning street out of focus behind
world.palette: Warm broth red-orange against cool grey steel; herb green as the only accent
world.lens_family: 35mm equivalent for the wide shots, 60mm equivalent macro for the detail shots, no zoom inside a shot

shots.action: A ladle lifts out of the pot and pours broth into the waiting bowl; steam climbs and bends away from the pour
shots.framing: Macro on the pour, bowl rim across the lower third
shots.camera: Slow push in, 10cm over the shot

set.gaze: no face in frame; the action holds the eye
set.hand: right hand holds the ladle, left hand steadies the bowl
set.light_direction: soft key 45 degrees camera-left, from the street doorway
set.prop_placement: stock pot camera-left, stacked bowls camera-right, chopstick jar behind the bowl
set.material_state: steam rising continuously and dispersing upward; broth filling to two thirds
set.wardrobe: rolled navy sleeves, plain apron, no watch or ring

shots.audio: Production sound: broth hitting ceramic, pot lid, street behind

shots.action: The finished bowl sits on the counter and reads as one complete dish; hands withdraw from frame
shots.framing: Three-quarter top-down on the whole bowl, full silhouette visible

set.hand: both hands leave frame to the right
set.material_state: steam thinner and slower now that the pour has stopped; broth level settled at two thirds

shots.action: Chopsticks lift noodles clear of the broth; the strands separate and broth runs off them back into the bowl
shots.framing: Macro, lift crossing the upper two thirds
shots.camera: Slow lateral move right, following the lift
shots.transition: hard cut on the same action axis

set.hand: right hand holds the chopsticks, left hand steadies the bowl rim

shots.audio: Production sound: broth dripping, noodles separating

shots.action: Shank and pork knuckle rest in the open stock pot, the surface moving at a low simmer
shots.framing: Macro into the pot, surface across the middle third
shots.reason: The pot is what the broth claim rests on; it is a different subject, so the cut is a cutaway rather than a continuation

set.prop_placement: pot centred, bowl out of frame, chopstick jar out of frame
set.material_state: low simmer with slow surface movement, steam rising continuously

shots.action: The complete bowl again, held still with room above it for type
shots.framing: Three-quarter top-down, bowl in the lower two thirds, upper third empty for copy
shots.transition: hard cut back to the bowl
shots.reason: Return to the recognition framing so the last frame is the dish, not the kitchen

set.prop_placement: bowl centred, stacked bowls camera-right, pot out of frame
set.material_state: steam thin and slow; broth level unchanged
